reviewer_measurements.volatility: free space moved by ~4 GiB within ~60 seconds while the volume repeatedly sat at 100% capacity

F3_disk_capacity.reasoning: headroom is not merely low, it is VOLATILE (2-6 GiB band, volume repeatedly at 100%). A governed multi-gigabyte run needs a stable minimum, not a lucky window. The failure mode is uncontrolled: an ENOSPC mid-run aborts after partial writes, producing partial evidence that the programme treats as un-credible, and it can occur at a different point on each attempt.
F3_disk_capacity.minimum_repair: free a stable margin above the run's worst-case write set; prune or relocate the LOCAL_COURTS estate; enforce a checked minimum-free-space precondition in the live runner; re-measure immediately before launch
F3_disk_capacity.reviewer_side_disclosure: the reviewer's own temporary freeze worktree consumed ~1.5 GiB and pushed the volume to 100%; it was removed. Same hazard class as F3.
